title: p21ras is modified by a farnesyl isoprenoid
authors: Casey PJ, Solski PA, Der CJ, Buss JE
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
funder: National Institutes of Health grants CA42348 (to J.E.B.), CA42978 (to C.J.D.) and GM34497 (to A.G. Gilman); American Cancer Society Grant BC555K (to A.G. Gilman); the Schoenith Foundation (J.E.B.); National Research Service Award GM11982 (to P.J.C.).
result: Processing of ras proteins involves addition of a farnesyl moiety, apparently at the cysteine of the conserved COOH-terminal Cys-Ali-Ali-Xaa sequence, as in yeast a-factor mating hormone; the authors proposed that farnesylation is important for membrane association and transforming activity of ras proteins.
